Cache hit with OpenDAL memory backend returns cached response on repeat request

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:liter_llm/liter_llm.dart';
import 'package:liter_llm/src/liter_llm_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final req = await createChatCompletionRequestFromJson(json: '{"messages":[{"content":"Hello","role":"user"}],"model":"openai/gpt-4o"}');
    final client = await LiterLlmBridge.createClientFromJson('{"api_key":"your-api-key","cache":{"backend":"opendal:memory","max_entries":256,"ttl_seconds":300}}');
    final result = await client.chat(req: req);
    stdout.writeln(result);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
